description: WireGuard Config Audit — Offline security audit of a WireGuard wg0.conf / wg-quick config (server or client, auto-detected; role= server|client to force). Checks key format (private and preshared keys are never echoed), private key pasted as a peer public key, duplicate peers, AllowedIPs overlap between peers (silent traffic hijack), any-source AllowedIPs on a multi-peer server, full-tunnel IPv6 and DNS leaks, bad Endpoint/ListenPort/MTU, SaveConfig, PostUp hooks that download or pipe to a shell, NAT rules not removed in PostDown, keepalive and missing PresharedKey. Returns PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, score, grade, findings with fixes, parsed settings and a hardened server+client example. Pass the file in text= (URL-encoded, newlines as %0A). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
